sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 26 November 2007, in force 12 May 2010)
France–Hong Kong SAR Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (signed 13 March 1995, in force)
France–Morocco Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 25 September 1979, in force)
France–United Arab Emirates Bilateral Investment Treaty
France's DTAA network (over 120 double taxation agreements in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Loi n° 2016-1691 du 9 décembre 2016 (Sapin II), codified in Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L561-1 et seq. for AML/CFT and L561-45 to L561-58 for the Register of Beneficial Owners; Décret n° 2017-1094 du 13 juin 2017; Arrêté du 14 juin 2017; Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843, transposed by Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 12 février 2020 and Décret n° 2021-899; Tracfin Suspicious Transaction reporting under CMF L561-15 et seq.; restrictive financial measures under CMF L562-1 et seq.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statuts constitutifs (draft articles of association of the SARL) executed by all founding shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founders (notary if a notarized deed is required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If signed outside France, each signature must be notarized and the notarial certificate apostilled (Hague) or legally consularized (non-Hague); French-resident signatories may sign original statuts privately, with legalization only for annexes; French sworn translation of all non-French language pages required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate power of attorney (mandat/pouvoir) of each foreign corporate shareholder authorizing the local incorporator/managing director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or equivalent corporate body of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Board resolution notarized; the notary act then receives Hague Apostille or consular legalization; followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate shareholder's certificate of registration, good standing or UBO extract/historic register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or authorized official registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Official extract with Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague) and French sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial-owner identity and eligibility package (passport copies, proof of residential address, bank reference, source-of-funds declarations for each UBO and manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each UBO/manager and, where applicable, the foreign AML-regulated intermediary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true-copy certifications; apostille/consular legalization required for foreign-issued certificates; all documents must be transliterated/translated into French by a sworn translator

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and continuous screening: (1) verify identities and beneficial ownership; (2) screen against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN lists, and France's national restrictive measures lists under CMF L562-1 et seq.; (3) screen all shareholders, UBOs, managers and commercial counterparties for PEP status under FATF Recommendation 12 and local AMLD4/5 rules; foreign PEPs (notably from EU Member States) require enhanced due diligence covering source of wealth/funds and senior-management approval; (4) internally document negative/positive hits and file any suspicious activity report ('déclaration de soupçon') with Tracfin when required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Formalités des entreprises (Guichet unique) via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; public name/trademark check through INPI Data (data.inpi.fr) and Infogreffe (RCS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory filings and register entries are in French. The corporate name must be in Latin script and must include the suffix 'SARL'. Names originating in non-Latin scripts (Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, etc.) are entered in the official Latin alphabet transliteration only; the foreign-script form (if any) is ornamental and does not confer a distinct corporate name. Names may not be identical, phonetically identical, or dangerously similar to another registered RCS name. Advertising/trading names (enseigne) may be registered in another script separately but are not relied upon for corporate legal capacity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, Finance, Crédit (financial vocabulary requiring prior authorization from the Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority)
Assurance, Réassurance, Mutuelle, Mutualité (insurance society vocabulary requiring regulatory authorization)
État, République, Président, Préfecture, Commune (sovereignty/public-authority terms likely to mislead)
Chambre de commerce, Chambre des métiers (statutory chamber names protected by law)
SA, SAS, SC, SE or other legal form suffixes that imply a corporate form different from the registered SARL
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a standalone name-reservation database; the protected name arises on registration. If the formation portal rejects a name for conflict, the applicant may: (a) submit an amended name immediately; (b) if legal deceptiveness is the ground, make a written representation to the Guichet unique or INPI within 15 days of rejection; (c) if rejected again, apply by summons (assignation en référé) to the President of the tribunal judiciaire within 1 month, seeking an order that the name be registered; (d) appeal the resulting court order to the cour d'appel. A trademark-infringement rejection is normally addressed by withdrawing the offending name and filing a distinct name rechecked against INPI and RCS.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Yes, legally permitted under Article L123-11-3 of the Code de commerce through a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation), and acceptable for registration and tax correspondence. For a deep-sea Ro-Ro vehicle carrier, however, the French tax administration and customs expect a physical place of business (bureau), current books, and operational documents; a pure virtual office should not be used if the company claims a permanent establishment, VAT registration, or customs indirect representation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-Moderate: approximately 20% to 30% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months if the SARL is VAT-registered and enters into shipping/chartering contracts in France; the probability rises to 40% or more once French customs indirect representation, crew employment, or Tracfin alerting is present.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutes/incorporation deed drafting by a French avocat, including English/French dual language pack
Notarization of statutes, corporate shareholder resolutions and powers of attorney (if required)
Filing and registration of the SARL with the Guichet unique, RCS and INPI (including statute deposit and legal form checks)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / INPI

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation legal notice in an authorized Journal d'annonces légales
Apostille and/or consular legalization of foreign-issued corporate, UBO and identity document package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Hague Convention competent authorities and/or French/foreign consulates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document official tariff plus agent handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French sworn translations of foreign documents necessary for registration and banks
UBO declaration compilation and AML/KYC compliance pack, including PEP, OFAC, UN, EU and French sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French compliance provider/AML officer (avocat or corporate services firm)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Flat market rate per corporate onboarding file

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency for a non-cash contribution audit report (rapport du commissaire aux apports) if the Ro-Ro shipping project contributes vessels or assets in-kind
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark (1,000–3,000 EUR); nil if all-cash capital contribution

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-31; general formation provisions under Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10; maritime armament authorization under Code des transports, Articles L.5222-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), with filings submitted through the Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration unique de constitution de société et statuts originaux déposés via le Guichet Unique (formulaire M0)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a French SARL; the articles may fix the share capital freely. Each part sociale must be fully paid-up at subscription. Cash contributions must be deposited into a blocked bank escrow account or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and may be released to the managers only after RCS registration. In-kind contributions require a Commissaire aux apports valuation report where one contribution exceeds €30,000 or exceeds half of the share capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION — SHARE SUBSCRIPTION, STATUTORY OFFICE AND MANAGER APPOINTMENT. All shareholders, duly convened, RESOLVE: (1) The SARL's stated capital, fully allocated as quotas as set out in the articles, is accepted; each subscriber acknowledges payment or promise of consideration in compliance with Code de commerce articles L.223-7 and L.223-8. (2) The registered office is fixed at [registered address] within the jurisdiction of the Greffe du tribunal de commerce de [city]. (3) [Name] and [Name] are appointed as co-gérants/managers for an unlimited term with full corporate powers to represent the company in the deep-sea Ro-Ro vehicle transport business. (4) The managers are authorised to sign the formation filing, publish legal notices and undertake all formalities to obtain its Kbis. Unanimous.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and INPI corporate data portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name and verify the RCS/INPI database for identical or confusingly similar registered names, trademarks and legal entities in France. Where conflict exists, select a qualifying distinctive alternative name and reserve all planned corporate documentation accordingly.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and alternatives
Summary of the statutory object for deep-sea Ro-Ro vehicle transport
Identity details of the incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen name is refused or challenged as identical to an existing RCS/SIREN name, file a modified name through the Guichet Unique before the final incorporation submission; the initial search fee is not lost if the full formation package has not yet been filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and signing of the SARL articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All founding shareholders; optional notarial authentication by a French notaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare full statuts containing the mandatory SARL clauses under Articles L.223-1, L.223-7, L.223-8, L.223-18 and R.223-3 of the Code de commerce; define the object as deep-sea Ro-Ro vessel vehicle transport; allocate quotas; designate the registered office and management. All shareholders or their authorized representatives must sign the statuts. Notarization is mandatory only where a real-property contribution is made or when the parties elect notarial deed status.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts
Passport or identity documents of each associate
Registry extracts of corporate shareholders, if applicable
Power of attorneys for any signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a mandatory statutory clause is omitted, the Guichet Unique or Greffe will issue a query; execute a corrective rectification deed and re-file the consolidated statuts within the notified cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: In-kind contribution valuation and escrow deposit of paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or statutory auditor (Commissaire aux apports)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the SARL in formation and deposit all cash contributions. Obtain the bank attestation de dépôt des fonds. Appoint a Commissaire aux apports and secure the valuation report where any in-kind contribution has a value exceeding €30,000 or exceeds one-half of the share capital. The funds remain blocked until the RCS extracts Kbis and the company is registered.
required_dossiers: Bank deposit attestation
Commissaire aux apports report, if applicable
Escrow account identification and signatory mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the temporary account opening due to compliance verification, select another licensed French credit institution; if the attestation contains a name mismatch, obtain a corrected attestation and re-submit through the Guichet Unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the formation notice in a Journal d'annonces légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed legal announcement newspaper (JAL) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate particulars for the legal announcement, including corporate name, corporate form, registered office, capital amount, managers and the competent RCS court. After acceptance, the JAL issues the attestation de parution required for file registration.
required_dossiers: Project of statuts
Completed legal announcement form
Power of attorney or shareholder authorization for the publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the advertisement is rejected for missing legal particulars, correct the insertion text and publish a replacement announcement; then provide the JAL rectification attestation with the formation file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the incorporation dossier with the RCS through the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises; Greffe du tribunal de commerce with territorial jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online statement of incorporation, attach all required dossiers, execute the electronic signature and pay the registry fees. The Greffe verifies the statutory legality of the statuts and the completeness of the file before entering the company in the RCS.
required_dossiers: Signed original or certified copy of statuts
Legal announcement attestation
Bank deposit attestation and apport report, if applicable
Declaration of non-conviction and appointment acceptance of managers
Proof of registered-office address or domiciliation agreement
Identity documents of shareholders and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the registrar issues a formal request for completion, the applicant must cure omissions or inconsistencies within the notified period; if the dossier is closed, a fresh filing may be made, and any paid fees generally remain attached to the corrected new filing when the entity has not yet been registered.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and extraction of Kbis and SIREN/SIRET numbers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and INSEE statistical office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After validation by the Greffe, the company is assigned a SIREN number and entered in the RCS. The Greffe issues the official Kbis extract, which constitutes the legal prima facie proof of corporate existence and capacity.
required_dossiers: Guichet Unique filing reference
Payment confirmation of registry fees
Final as-filed statuts with annexes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is delayed, contact the Greffe and request a provisional certificate or certificate of pending registration; if details are erroneous, submit a rectification request through the dedicated RCS correction procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation governance organization and statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company manager; Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for incidental filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the operational corporate bank account using the Kbis and SIRET number; create the shareholders' register of decisions (registre des délibérations); maintain a register of movements of quotas; ensure the signed manager appointment and acceptance are archived. If statutory thresholds are reached, appoint an auditor.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
Manager appointment resolution
Identity documents of the initial manager
Proof of registered-office occupation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or a third party disputes the Kbis, obtain a certified registry extract; if the statutory auditor threshold is exceeded, convene an extraordinary associates' meeting immediately to appoint a Commissaire aux comptes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Maritime armament authorization, flag registration and vessel operating certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Générale des Affaires Maritimes, de la Pêche et de l'Aquaculture (DGAMPA), Direction interrégionale de la mer (DIRM), and the ship's flag-state authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If operating under the French flag, submit the armement au commerce declaration and apply for vessel francisation, flag registry, radio licence, ISM Company Document of Compliance, ISPS Ship Security Certificate and the vessel's titre de navigation. Where the vessel remains under another EU/EEA flag, the SARL must nonetheless satisfy French establishment, crew and company safety management obligations.
required_dossiers: Armateur declaration and corporate Kbis
Proof of vessel ownership, bareboat charter or long-term time charter
ISM Company Document of Compliance and safety management manual
Marine hull and P&I insurance certificates
Vessel construction and equipment certificates
Oil pollution emergency plan and waste-reception contracts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the maritime administration queries the application, submit supplementary compliance documents within the statutory deadline; if authorization is refused, pursue an administrative appeal within two months under the Code des relations entre le public et l'administration, after correcting all safety, certification or crew deficiencies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Générale des Affaires Maritimes, de la Pêche et de l'Aquaculture (DGAMPA) under the Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires; local Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) for shore-based installations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'armement au commerce et titre de navigation/francisation du navire, in accordance with the French Code des transports and applicable EU maritime regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Agence de l'environnement et de la maîtrise de l'énergie (ADEME); Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) under the Ministry of Ecological Transition
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Registration / No standalone full EIA Report for mobile deep-sea vessel operations; mandatory EU MRV CO2 registration, SEEMP and MARPOL certification. A full environmental impact assessment under the Code de l'environnement, Articles L.122-1 et seq., will apply if the company constructs or substantially alters port, terminal or shipyard infrastructure.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: MARPOL Annex I: zero oil-discharge and segregated ballast treatment; Annex IV sewage discharges only beyond specified distance and with approved treatment; Annex V garbage and waste delivered to port reception facilities; Annex VI marine engine emission limits with global sulphur cap of 0.50% m/m and 0.10% m/m in approved SECA/Mediterranean SOx Emission Control Areas; NOx Tier III limits where applicable; IMO D-2 ballast water management standards; EU MRV Regulation (EU) 2015/757 CO2 reporting; FuelEU Maritime greenhouse gas intensity reduction requirements commencing 2025.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: SOLAS-certified Fire Safety System Certificate and International Load Line Certificate; structural load line inspections and hull surveys by an approved classification society; ISPS Ship Security Certificate; occupational health and safety clearance by French maritime labor inspection authorities; workplace risk assessment, fire safety control measures and structural load clearance for the corporate registered office or any shore facility occupied by the company.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – French Public Finance Directorate; business portal: impots.gouv.fr and Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) for e-invoicing
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must first establish a French fixed base or permanent establishment (or incorporate/register an existing SARL through the Guichet Unique). The SARL obtains its SIREN (national business identifier) and SIRET (establishment number) from the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the INPI single window. For VAT purposes, the entity must apply to the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) for a French VAT number (TVA intracommunautaire) using Form M0 or the online e-procédure; foreign taxable persons that carry out taxable transactions in France may also request direct VAT registration under Article 286 ter of the French General Tax Code (CGI), with supporting evidence of legal existence (certificate of incorporation, registered office, proof of economic activity in France). The application must specify the nature of the activity and estimated French turnover; a valid French VAT number is normally issued within 2 to 4 weeks after receipt of a complete file. Separate registrations may be required for payroll (URSSAF) and customs (EORI number) where goods movements occur.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: French law does not provide a check-the-box regime. A SARL is by default subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). However, certain small SARLs may elect, under Article 239 bis AA CGI, to be taxed as a partnership (régime des sociétés de personnes) on a five-year renewable basis if the members are natural persons and the company meets specified size thresholds. VAT grouping (assujetti unique) is available under Article 256 C CGI with effect from 1 January 2023 for French-established entities and certain non-established entities, allowing combined filing. No hybrid mismatch 'check-the-box' election exists; hybrid mismatch disallowances are implemented under ATAD (Articles 212 bis A and following CGI) and may require notification of mismatch arrangements to the DGFiP.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For French-established small businesses, the VAT exemption threshold is EUR 85,000 for principal activities involving sale of goods and EUR 37,500 for principal service activities (Article 293 B CGI). However, the place of supply for a RoRo maritime transport service between France and a third country is generally outside France under Article 259 B CGI, and therefore a foreign carrier providing such services may not need French VAT registration. French VAT registration is mandatory for any business established in France making taxable supplies, without a turnover threshold, and for foreign providers using a French VAT registration for supplies of services where the place of supply is France under B2B or B2C rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is phasing in mandatory B2B e-invoicing and e-reporting. Under the Finance Act 2023, businesses established in France must issue invoices electronically via the PPF (Portail Public de Facturation) or a certified Private Dematerialization Platform (PDP) from 1 September 2026 for large enterprises and from 1 September 2027 for small and medium-sized enterprises. Structured e-invoicing formats (Factur-X, UBL, CII) and transaction data (e-reporting) are transmitted to the DGFiP through the PPF or PDP APIs in near real time. There is no digital stamping or VAT fiscalization requirement for ordinary invoices; however, for customs and export goods, the export declaration must be submitted electronically through the DELTA system and validated by French Customs.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) applies to the export of goods outside the European Union under Article 262-0 CGI, and to international transport services involving transportation of goods between a point in France or another EU Member State and a point outside the EU, and to maritime transport services directly linked to those exports/imports (Article 262-1 CGI). For a RoRo vessel carrying vehicles between France and a non-EU port, the ocean freight and related transport services are zero-rated where the transport is direct and is evidenced as cross-border services. The supply must be made to a customer established outside the EU, or the transport must physically commence or terminate at a non-EU port. Services physically performed wholly outside the EU are outside the scope of French VAT. The taxpayer must hold documentary evidence of the international character of the voyage and, if goods are co-loaded, the customs export or import declaration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'exportation via DELTA/SWIFT) – required where vehicles or goods are physically exported; for a service-only RoRo voyage, a commercial invoice and voyage service contract serve in lieu
Bill of Lading (Connaissement / B/L) – issued for vehicles carried by sea; must indicate loading port and discharge port, vessel name, consignee, and cargo description

Inward Remittance Certificate (or equivalent bank SWIFT MT103 / receipt of payment from the foreign charterer or freight payer) – substantiates receipt of the international transport consideration for the zero-rating claim
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax administration can retrospectively deny zero-rating if the documentary evidence is inadequate, misfiled, or if the transport is not genuinely international. Under Articles 1728 and 1729 CGI, a deliberate VAT under-payment or misclassification attracts a penalty of 40% (serious inaccuracy) or 80% (deliberate fraud), plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month (Article 1727 CGI). Customs offences relating to false export declarations or falsified transport documents are sanctioned under Articles 414-2 and 415-1 of the French Customs Code and may include confiscation of goods, vessel sanctions, criminal fines up to twice the value of the subject goods, and imprisonment. Clawbacks may extend to recovered VAT credits plus penalties and may jeopardize the VAT registration status of the operator.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), operating within the Eurosystem, jointly overseeing exchange-control statistics and balance-of-payments reporting with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury); prudential supervision of credit institutions and payment service providers is delegated to the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a Eurozone member and maintains full current-account and capital-account convertibility under the Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L151-1 et seq.; no administrative authorization is required for routine trade, service, or financial cross-border flows. Practical hurdles are limited to: (i) mandatory Banque de France balance-of-payments (couverture statistique) reporting for every cross-border payment equal to or exceeding EUR 750,000 and for all foreign direct investments regardless of amount; (ii) EU and French foreign-investment screening under Regulation (EU) 2019/452 and CMF filed reporting requirements, which may apply only where the SARL controls critical infrastructure, including certain port/maritime critical assets — deep-sea RoRo car-carrier vessel operation is not per se screened but French-registered vessel-owning assets may trigger notification; (iii) profit remittance to foreign shareholders is unrestricted once tax compliance is evidenced through the issuance of a tax clearance certificate (nihil obstat) by the French tax administration; no other FX or transfer approvals apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion obligation. The SARL may retain 100% of its USD freight income, demurrage, ancillary RoRo handling fees, and charter-hire proceeds in foreign-currency accounts with any authorized credit institution indefinitely. There is no prescribed timeline for conversion into EUR and no minimum conversion ratio; the treasury may voluntarily maintain USD balances to match USD-denominated liabilities or hedge into EUR. The sole compliance duty is statistical: the resident bank reports all cross-border flows of EUR 750,000 or more per transaction to the Banque de France, and invoices denominated in USD are freely permitted under French law.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account (compte courant) with dedicated shipping desk
Operational Account with USD Clearing Facility via Société Générale New York

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (Crédit Agricole CIB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Trade Finance Account for Commercial LC issuance under UCP 600
Operational Account linked to structured ship-finance relationships
Multi-currency Operational Account with CHIPS/Fedwire USD correspondent access
Operational Account for domestic disbursement and SEPA payroll

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium-to-Low as primary treasury and High as a sub-operational wallet. French and EU-passported electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Qonto, Wise Business, Revolut Business, and Bunq are payment institutions under the Payment Services Directive (EU) 2015/2366 and CMF Book V; they cannot lawfully take deposits, issue letters of credit, provide documentary trade finance, or hold a capital-escrow mandate because a capital increase deposit requires a licensed credit institution (établissement de crédit) or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations. Legal constraints also include safeguarded-account segregation rather than commercial deposit protection, inability to provide MT103-backed correspondent clearing for large USD flows, and practical ACPR-driven friction where the aggregate monthly throughput exceeds the EUR 750,000 balance-of-payments reporting threshold. Recommended use: port disbursement cards, crew expense cards, and small-value SEPA direct debits only; the capital escrow and all LC operations must remain with Tier-1 credit institutions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory in-person interview practice under ACPR enforcement of CMF Articles L561-5 and L561-5-1: at least one physical appearance of the SARL's legal representative (gérant) and every ultimate beneficial owner is required at a French branch, preferably in Paris or at a major maritime financial center (Marseille, Le Havre), before the account is activated. Remote video-ident identification is permitted as a supplementary step only where all UBOs are resident in low-risk countries and no high-risk jurisdiction link exists, but French Tier-1 banks uniformly apply a waterproof in-person first-meeting standard for SARLs with non-resident ownership. Practical timeline: allow 3 to 5 business days in France for the interview, submission of original notarized board resolutions, apostilled corporate documents (if executed outside France), and the notarized SARL deed (statuts) and deposit certificate. The capital escrow account will in virtually all cases require a physical branch visit; the operational account may be opened in the same meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBOs and manager with no verifiable physical presence or business substance in France, creating a shell-company red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: (i) K-bis extract showing the French registered office; (ii) wet-leased office or crew-management agreement with French counterparty; (iii) French payroll and URSSAF social-security filings for at least two employees; (iv) vessel registration and international security (ISPS) certificates proving operational assets; (v) an updated French merchant-shipping or Chamber of Shipping membership; and (vi) a 12-month business plan attached to firm charter parties and booking notes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk or zero-tax jurisdiction located anywhere in the upstream ownership or financing chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: complete ownership chain from SARL to ultimate individuals with tax-residency certificates issued by the relevant revenue authority; apostilled passport and source-of-wealth affidavit for each UBO; affirmative sanctions-screening outputs covering UN, EU, UK OFSI, and US OFAC lists; a notarial declaration of good title and unencumbered source of funds; and, if applicable, explanations of any trust or foundation with supporting constitutive deeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection remitted from third-party or indirect sources, or through payment intermediaries not recognized by the French bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: signed memorandum of agreement (MOA) or bill of sale if funds arise from vessel disposal; original loan or financing agreement if the shareholder drew debt; bank reference letter from the remitting institution covering the prior 12-month relationship; the pre-incorporation deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds) issued by the depository bank; and a French counsel legal opinion confirming the permissibility of the capital contribution under CMF and exchange-control rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: RoRo automotive shipping risk of dual-use vehicle cargo or exposure to sanctioned parties (e.g., consignees in embargoed destinations or flagged vessels under restrictive measures).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: internal sanctions-compliance policy and implementation evidence; EU dual-use and arms/export licences (if any) covering cargo; OEM or manufacturer declarations that cargo is civil-market only; sanctions screening results for each charterer, shipper, consignee, and beneficial cargo owner; flag-state certificates and AIS track records; and a compliance undertaking signed by the gérant accepted by the bank's compliance function.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial-ownership structure, dormant SARL, or delayed UBO registry disclosure at the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: current Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs filing receipt; a certified shareholder register (registre des mouvements de titres); statutory auditor (Commissaire aux comptes) confirmation of ownership percentages; and a formal UBO breakdown chart signed by the manager, fully reconcilable with the K-bis and the bank's PSC templates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) open a blocked capital escrow account (compte bloqué) at a Tier-1 French credit institution acting as depository; (2) the shareholder effects payment via SWIFT MT103 with the following content — Field 50K (ordering institution) must show the shareholder's identity, Field 59 (beneficiary) must show the SARL French IBAN and SIRET/SIREN, Field 70 in narrative must state 'AUGMENTATION DE CAPITAL SARL [name]' and reference the extraordinary general meeting date; French banks map this to Banque de France purpose code '6.26' (direct investment / equity); (3) if the shareholder is a non-EU person or entity, file the French Treasury foreign direct investment declaration (CERFA 14959*03) with the Direction Générale du Trésor and the Banque de France within 20 days of the transaction; intra-EU shareholders benefit from the EU-investor exemption from prior notification; (4) the bank will release escrow funds into the operational account only upon delivery of the notarized capital-increase minutes, the subscription certificate (acte de souscription), updated K-bis, and, if required by law or the bank, a statutory auditor's report on the capital increase. Aggregate transfers with a value equal to or above EUR 750,000 are automatically declared by the French bank to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistical purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing hierarchy for operational and trade disbursements: (i) SWIFT MT103 (single-charge 'OUR' structure preferred) is used for charter-hire, bunker-supplier payments, port disbursements, stevedoring, crew agency fees, and broker commissions, with the related invoice number and contract reference in Field 70; (ii) Irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued by the French Tier-1 bank and payable under UCP 600 are the mandated rail for shipyard installments, vessel acquisition deposits under memorandum of agreement, and any major equipment supply; for demand guarantees and refund guarantees URDG 758 applies; (iii) in EUR, TARGET2 transfers are available through the French bank as the primary rail for high-value payments, while SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant are used for domestic payroll and low-value disbursements; (iv) in USD, the preferred correspondent rails are CHIPS and Fedwire via the bank's New York branch (BNP Paribas New York or Société Générale New York), with instructions to debit in USD only and all charges applied to benefiter; (v) every disbursement equal to or exceeding EUR 750,000 triggers a Banque de France statistical balance-of-payments declaration, filed by the French bank; the SARL's treasury must provide documentary support (commercial invoice, booking note, bill of lading, charter-party excerpt) to each payment instruction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward (EUR/USD outright) with tenors up to 12 months, entered into exclusively with an ACPR-licensed credit institution and documented under an ISDA or French master agreement; no margin required for interbank relationship lines.

FX Swap (short-dated swap cambiste) for liquidity and maturity-mismatch management between USD freight receipts and EUR operating expenses, including spot-next and tom-next rolling swaps where operational.

Zero-Cost Collar structured as a European-style option pair (long call / short put) on EUR/USD matched to the forecast cargo-flow schedule, permitted only with board approval and set within conservative treasury policy limits.

Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swap (CCIRS) to convert USD-denominated ship-finance term-loan liabilities into EUR or to synthetically match long-term USD charter income with EUR balance-sheet exposure; hedging eligibility requires that a directly related USD debt or firm freight contract exists.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting approbation of statutory financial statements and gérant management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SARL corporate minute book; subsequent registration effected through the annual accounts deposit at the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the close of the financial year (C. com. art. L.223-26); for a single-member SARL (EURL), the sole-associate decision is executed within the same statutory period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure of the gérant to convene the annual meeting within six months is punishable by a criminal fine of up to EUR 15,000; the court may also order convocation on the application of any shareholder; the annual accounts cannot validly be deposited without the approval decision

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels: balance sheet, income statement, annexes, and auditor's report where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) filed electronically through the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of the shareholders' approval and, in any case, no later than six months after the financial year-end (C. com. arts. L.232-22 and R.232-6); BODACC publication follows automatically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine of up to EUR 9,000 imposed on the gérant for non-filing (C. com. art. L.241-8); the Commercial Court may order filing under a coercive fine (astreinte); persistent omission over successive years triggers an administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS and exclusion from public contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale: Form 2065-SD, 2050-series tables, and the tonnage-tax schedule where the maritime election applies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — mandatory electronic filing (EFI/EDI transmission)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year financial period: not later than the second working day following 1 May (ordinarily 3 or 5 May); for a non-calendar year-end: within three months of the close of the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the corporation tax due, increased to 10% if the return is not filed within 30 days of the first formal demand (CGI art. 1728); late-payment interest at 0.20% per month (CGI art. 1727); automatic tax assessment (taxation d'office); forfeiture of the tonnage-tax regime for material non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of RCS registration data and beneficial-owner (UBO) declaration recertification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS through the INPI Guichet Unique; UBO declaration maintained in the registry file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month following the company's registration anniversary date; any change in beneficial ownership occurring during the year (e.g., share transfer) must be declared to the registry within 30 days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Protracted failure to confirm the RCS record exposes the company to the administrative strike-off procedure under C. com. art. R.123-126; false or incomplete UBO declarations are punishable by up to six months' imprisonment and a EUR 7,500 fine (art. L.561-48 CMF), with joint liability of the gérant

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory for a French SARL where, at the close of the financial year, the company exceeds two of the three thresholds: total balance sheet over EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees (C. com. art. L.223-35). Appointment is also mandatory upon the request of shareholders holding at least one-tenth of the share capital, where the SARL controls or is controlled by an entity exceeding the thresholds, or where required by consolidation rules of a group parent.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP pursuant to Règlement ANC n°2014-03 (Plan Comptable Général). Annual accounts comprise the balance sheet, income statement, and annex notes. The deep-sea RoRo operator may elect the French maritime tonnage-tax regime under CGI art. 209-0 B septies for eligible vessels; the annual return then combines the French-GAAP result of non-eligible activities with a per-vessel tonnage computation. Statutory books, supporting invoices, and corporate registers must be retained for ten years (C. com. art. L.123-22).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL files a declaration of beneficial owners (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) with the RCS at incorporation and must update it within 30 days of any share transfer or change in direct or indirect control (art. L.561-47 CMF). At least once per calendar year the UBO data is recertified through the annual RCS confirmation; the gérant verifies that the declared beneficial owners still correspond to the registered cap table before submitting the confirmation. A share transfer occurring in the year requires a separate modification filing (cession de parts and updated UBO declaration) prior to the annual confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members/shareholders (registre des associés) documenting the cap table and share-transfer history
Register of directors/gérant mandates (registre des mandats sociaux) recording appointments, revocations, and executive powers
Minute book (registre des décisions des associés) containing AGM minutes, sole-associate decisions, and attendance sheets
Register of share transfers and capital transactions (registre des cessions de parts sociales) maintained at the registered office

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 600 - 1,800 USD per annum for a commercial registered office and corporate secretarial agent in Paris, Le Havre, or Marseille; the range covers domiciliation, mail handling, RCS correspondence, and registered-agent support for the annual confirmation filings
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 4,000 - 14,000 USD for a full statutory audit (commissariat aux comptes) of a mid-size RoRo operating SARL once the legal thresholds are exceeded; 2,500 - 7,000 USD for a review mission (mission de présentation des comptes) or a voluntary audit for a company remaining below the thresholds

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (crédit d'impôt recherche) of up to 30% of eligible R&D expenditures; no general tax holidays or preferential rates

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 1201 - Déclaration de résultat (corporate income tax return) filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g. 31 March for calendar year-end 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Résultat fiscal avant application des régimes particuliers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit or loss before special regimes and adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for French SARL residents; non-residents report through permanent establishment if applicable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for depreciation, provisions, and other allowable expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for arm's length pricing and economic substance requirements

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits such as R&D credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claimable only if entity qualifies as French tax resident

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 0.75% per month of the tax due, capped at 10%; non-filing incurs additional 40% penalty plus criminal prosecution

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12.8% on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders (treaty rates typically 0%, 5%, or 15%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: File TRC (Demande de réduction de retenue à la source) with French tax authorities, including beneficial ownership declaration, treaty article reference, and supporting evidence
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% (intra-EU) to 10% (treaty-dependent); Interest: 0% (related party) to 12.8% (treaty-dependent, often reduced to 0% for related party debt)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory mandatory threshold; recommended for related party transactions exceeding €1 million or as part of group-wide compliance
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies transfer pricing rules and anti-avoidance provisions to ensure economic substance; no general Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) but compliance with OECD guidelines required for cross-border activities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of income or overstatement of deductions through fictitious transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty of up to 80% of evaded tax plus interest; imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, obligation to repay evaded tax with surcharges, possible disqualification from corporate offices, and entry bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining a company without real business activities or decision-making in France
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €1 million or 10% of annual turnover; potential criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal restitution of tax benefits, imprisonment up to 2 years, and disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform due diligence on beneficial owners or cross-border payment flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €1 million or 5% of turnover; criminal penalties up to 10 years imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, fines, and possible prison sentence for willful non-compliance
